desc:
🪖 Take command of World War 1! Lead your own squad of soldiers into huge battles between the Allies and the Central Powers.

🎖️ Commander | 🚜 Tank | 💥 Artillery | ✈️ Pilot
Pick your role and decide how the battle is won.

⚔️ Capture checkpoints, hold the line and push the front forward
🐎 Level up your squads from 19 nations
🚩 Join a regiment and fight beside your friends
🏆 Rank up and climb the Top 100

🚀 v1.0 - Full release!
